profile.ja:
五車学園を卒業したばかりの対魔忍。
同級生の穂稀なおとは幼馴染。
一見根暗そうな隠れ美人で、声が小さ過ぎて無口だと思われているが、実は話し好き。
親友の穂稀なおにだけは何故か彼女の声が聞きとれるらしい。魂遁の術“黄泉録り”の使い手で、
死体に触れて霊魂の情報を読み取る。霊魂の情報とは、死因や遺伝情報といった科学的情報の他、
強く残っている思念、記憶といったもの。まさに五車のスーパー監察医である。
逸刀流の剣士でもあり、居合使いとして一流の腕前を持つ。
霊魂の手で超高速居合をしているとの噂もあるが、真偽は定かではない。
神のいたずらによりイマジナリー妊娠をさせられてしまった孤路。
意外に戸惑いなく受け入れて、ひとときの我が子を慈しんでいるようだ。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin who has just graduated from Gosha Academy. Her classmate Homare Nao is her childhood friend. She appears as a gloomy hidden beauty and is thought to be taciturn because her voice is so soft, but she actually loves to talk. For some reason only her best friend Homare Nao can hear her voice clearly. She is the user of the soul-stealing technique "Yomi-roku," reading spirits' information by touching corpses. That information includes scientific data such as cause of death and genetics as well as strongly lingering thoughts and memories. She is literally Gosha's super forensic doctor. She is also a swordswoman of the Ittō style and possesses first-rate iaijutsu skill. Rumors claim she performs ultra-fast iaijutsu with a spirit hand, though the truth is uncertain. By a god's prank she was made imaginatively pregnant. She accepted it without much hesitation and seems to be cherishing her brief child.
